optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Area Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled with weapons that affect an area. You gain the following benefits:

items: When a creature successfully saves against your projector canister, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to force them to repeat the save.
When a creature rolls a 1 on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a projector canister you control, they treat the effect's damage as if it had rolled the maximum.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Assisting Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at enabling your allies. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can take the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. If you could already take the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can instead take it as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} on your turn.

Creatures benefiting from your {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the affected {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Berserk Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at returning pain to those who deliver it. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you hit with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} using Strength, you deal additional damage equal to your Strength modifier if that creature dealt damage to you since the start of your last turn.
When you choose to let an attack that would miss you hit you instead, the creature rolls the damage as normal instead of choosing the maximum.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Blindfighting Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at fighting without sight. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight} out to 10 feet. If you already have {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight}, it instead increases by 10 feet.
You can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to double the range of your {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight} until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Brawler Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at using your weight to your {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. You gain the following benefits:

items: You are proficient with improvised weapons.

Your damage die for your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} and natural weapons increases by one step (from 1 to {@dice d4}, {@dice d4} to {@dice d6}, or {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}).

When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action and attempt to grapple, shove, or trip a creature, or make an attack against a creature with an unarmed strike or a weapon wielded in one hand on your turn, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to make an unarmed strike, grapple, shove, or trip against the same creature.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Counterstrike Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at returning attacks at those who dare strike you. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you would provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} on your turn, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to force the creature to make the {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack}, if it can.
Creatures who make {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} against you provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} from you.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Covert Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at fighting from unseen angles. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can take the {@action Hide|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. If you could already take the {@action Hide|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can instead take it as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} on your turn.
Creatures you've dealt damage to since the start of your last turn have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks made to find you.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Defense Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at the art of defending yourself. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you are wearing medium or {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor} with which you are proficient, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to mark a target within 30 feet that you can see until the end of your next turn. When you do so, damage dealt to you by the target is reduced by an amount equal to half your Strength or Constitution modifier (your choice, minimum of one) while marked. If this would reduce the damage to 0, the damage is instead reduced to 1. You can only have one creature marked in this way at a time.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength checks and Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid being moved.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Disruption Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: Choose one from force- or tech-casting. You are skilled at fighting and interfering with casters of the chosen type. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you force a creature to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on your turn, and they succeed on the save, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to force them to reroll the save. They must use the new roll.

Once per round, when a hostile creature attempts to cast a power while within 5 feet of you, they must first make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} as if to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} (DC = 10 + the power's level). On a failure, the power isn't cast and any points are wasted.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Dual Wield Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at fighting with two weapons. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you engage in Two-Weapon Fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage roll of your Two-Weapon Fighting attack as long as it doesn't already include that modifier.
You can draw or stow two weapons when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Duelist Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled in the art of fighting with a single weapon. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you are wielding a weapon in one hand with which you are proficient and no other weapons, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to feint. If you do so, you must make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) or Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check (your choice) contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check. On a success, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} you make against them before the start of your next turn.

While you are wielding a weapon in one hand with which you are proficient and no other weapons, when you miss with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} on your turn, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to repeat the attack against the same target. Any modifications to the original {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, such as {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}, {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, or without your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, also affect this {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.
Once on each of your turns, drawing or stowing a one-handed weapon no longer requires your object interaction.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Equilibrium Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at fighting without the confines of armor. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you are wearing light or no armor and not wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to mark a target within 30 feet that you can see until the end of your next turn. When you do so, you gain a bonus to AC and Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects the target controls equal to half your Dexterity modifier (minimum of +1) while marked. You can only have one creature marked in this way at a time.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity checks and Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid being moved.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Explosives Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at fighting with explosives. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can throw grenades and set mines with your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, instead of your action. If you could already throw grenades and set mines as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can instead do so as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} on your turn.
When a creature rolls a 1 on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a grenade, mine, or missile you control, they treat the effect's damage as if it had rolled the maximum.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Formation Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at fighting with a partner. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can take the {@action Guard|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. If you could already take the {@action Guard|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can instead take it as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} on your turn.

When you move on your turn, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to allow a willing ally within 5 feet of you to move with you (no action required by the ally). The ally must end this movement within 5 feet of you, and this movement can't exceed the ally's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.
When you choose to let an attack that would hit a guarded ally hit you instead, the creature rolls the damage as normal instead of choosing the maximum.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Formfighting Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} The ability to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}} You are skilled at the basics of the known forms of {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} combat. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn three {@book lightsaber forms|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}, detailed later in this chapter.
Once on each of your turns, you can draw or stow a {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} without using your object interaction.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Great Weapon Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at putting the weight of a weapon to your {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you are wielding a two-handed light- or vibro-weapon with which you are proficient, your weapon damage rolls gain a minimum roll threshold, discussed in chapter 7.
Grasping a two-handed weapon you are wielding in only one hand with your other hand no longer requires your object interaction.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Guerrilla Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at maneuvering across the battlefield. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can take the {@action Disengage|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. If you could already take the {@action Disengage|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can instead take it as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} on your turn.

When you take the {@action Disengage|sw5e-phb} action, you ignore unenhanced {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the first {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to avoid an effect that impairs your movement {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} or forces you to move before the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Gunning Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at using {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} in unique ways. You gain the following benefits:

items: When a creature rolls a 1 on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your burst or rapid property, they treat the effect's damage as if it had rolled the maximum.
When you use the burst property of a weapon, you can instead spray a line 20 feet long and 5 feet wide within range with shots.
When you use the rapid property of a weapon, when you roll the weapon's damage dice twice, you can double one set of the weapon's damage dice and forgo the other instead of adding them together.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Mounted Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at fighting while mounted. You gain the following benefits:

items: Mounting a vehicle or beast only uses 5 feet of your movement, provided you can reach it.
You can force an attack targeted at your mount to target you instead, provided you are a valid target for that attack.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Onslaught Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at using your momentum to your {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can take the {@action Dash|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. If you could already take the {@action Dash|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can instead take it as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} on your turn.

When you would make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} to attempt to shove or trip a creature, you can make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against the target's AC instead of a contested check. If you are wielding your weapon in two hands, you make this {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Poisoner Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at with the subtlety of poisons. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can apply poisons with your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, instead of your action. If you could already apply poisons as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can instead do so as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} on your turn.

When a creature rolls a 1 on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} you control, they treat the effect's damage as if it had rolled the maximum.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Secured Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at fighting with weapons in atypical places. You gain the following benefits:

items: At the start of each of your turns while wielding a fixed weapon, you can choose to treat the weapon as a light {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} until the start of your next turn. If you do so, you can't make attacks with the weapon for the duration.
You can benefit from fixed weapons while the hand is full.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Sentinel Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at techniques that take {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} of every drop in any enemy's guard. You gain the following benefits:

items: Creatures provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} when they move to within your reach or move 5 feet or greater while within your reach.

When you hit a creature that is no more than one size larger than you with an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack}, the creature gains 4 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} levels until the end of the current turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Sharpshooter Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled with firing at distant targets. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to mark a target greater than 30 feet from you that you can see. If you do so, and that target moves at least 5 feet before the start of your next turn, they provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} from you, and you can make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapon for that {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack}.

Your ranged weapon attacks reduce partial {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} by one step (from three-quarters to half or half to one-quarter) against targets greater than 30 feet from you. If the target has one-quarter {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}, you ignore it entirely.
Grasping a two-handed weapon you are wielding in only one hand with your other hand no longer requires your object interaction.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Shield Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at using your {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} to defend your allies as well as yourself. You gain the following benefits:

items: You are no longer restricted to wielding light weapons while wielding a heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}.
You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to try to shove or trip a creature within 5 feet of you with your {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}.

When you use a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} as an improvised weapon, you are considered proficient in it, light {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields} are considered to have the light and fixed weapon properties, and heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields} are considered to have the heavy weapon property.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Snapshot Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at getting up close and personal. You gain the following benefits:

items: You no longer have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on ranged weapon attacks due to being within 5 feet of a hostile creature.

Your ranged weapon attacks reduce partial {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} by one step (from three-quarters to half or half to one-quarter) against targets within 30 feet of you. If the target has one-quarter {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}, you ignore it entirely.
Your {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapon damage rolls against creatures within 30 feet of you gain a minimum roll threshold, discussed in chapter 7.
Grasping a two-handed weapon you are wielding in only one hand with your other hand no longer requires your object interaction.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Split Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at fighting with interlocking weapons. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you engage in Double-Weapon Fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} of your Double-Weapon Fighting attack as long as it doesn't already include that modifier.
When you engage in Two-Weapon Fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage roll of your Two-Weapon Fighting attack as long as it doesn't already include that modifier.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Spotting Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at keeping track of your surroundings. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can take the {@action Search|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. If you could already take the {@action Search|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can instead take it as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} on your turn.

You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to determine the nature of illusions. If you would already have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}, you can instead reroll one of the dice once.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Superiority Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at utilizing {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} to enhance your skills on the battlefield. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn one {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, detailed in {@book chapter 13|sw5e-phb|13}. Your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} is Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution for {@book physical maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Physical} (your choice), Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for {@book mental maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Mental} (your choice), and an ability of your choice for {@book general maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|General}.

You gain one superiority die, which is a {@dice d4}. This die changes as you gain levels: to {@dice d6} at 5th level, to {@dice d8} at 9th level, to {@dice d10} at 13th level, and to {@dice d12} at 17th level. A superiority die is expended when you use it. You regain all of your expended {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Throwing Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled with the techniques of throwing weapons. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you make a ranged attack with a thrown weapon, you can immediately draw another weapon.
Whenever you make a ranged attack with a thrown weapon, you can move up to 5 feet without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}.

When you miss with a ranged attack with a thrown weapon, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to repeat the attack against a creature within 15 feet and behind your initial target. Any modifications to the original {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, such as {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}, {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, or without your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, also affect this {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Twin-Blade Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at fighting with double-bladed weapons. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you engage in Double-Weapon Fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} of your Double-Weapon Fighting attack as long as it doesn't already include that modifier.
Grasping a double weapon you are wielding in only one hand with your other hand no longer requires your object interaction.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Versatile Style|sw5e-phb}
entries: You are skilled at using weapons in different ways. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you miss with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} on your turn while wielding a versatile weapon with which you are proficient in two hands, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to repeat the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against the same target using one hand. Any modifications to the original {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, such as {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}, {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, or without your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, also affect this {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.

When you miss with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} on your turn while wielding a versatile weapon with which you are proficient in one hand, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to attempt to shove or trip that creature. Any modifications to the original {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, such as {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}, {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, or without your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, also affect this {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}.
Grasping a versatile weapon you are wielding in only one hand with your other hand no longer requires your object interaction.
